description: This is an HTML source file implementing a web-based user interface for a database visualizer. It provides functionality for browsing databases and tables, and viewing data with features like horizontal scrolling, expandable cells, and real-time refresh.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resets UI states, and triggers data reload.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database's table list in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table, including handling of empty data and errors.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates the HTML for displaying table data, including header and data rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content based on the value type, with support for expandable content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Handles toggling the expanded view of cell content, supporting JSON objects and long text.
